title: hearty midnight pulled argentinian duck legs empanadas
description: rich, cheese-pull, midnight-craving argentinian dish featuring duck legs, rest-meat, diabetic-friendly-friendly, vessel=scallop-shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 C).
Rinse the duck legs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the duck legs to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through.
While the duck is cooking, mix the chimichurri sauce and shredded cheese in a small bowl.
Once the duck is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before shredding it with two forks.
Add the shredded duck to the bowl with the chimichurri sauce and cheese, and mix well.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add the shredded duck mixture to the flour mixture, mixing until a dough forms.
Wrap each scallop shell with the dough, making sure to seal the edges.
